$jsonSchema.title: Event Escrow Account Schema - OWASP Compliant
$jsonSchema.description: ET-FIN-001 escrow account. Rewritten: the previous validator required totalDeposited/availableBalance/pendingBalance and forbade every field the model actually writes, so every escrow write was rejected.

_class.description: Spring Data MongoDB's type hint. Written on every document by the mapping converter, so a validator with additionalProperties:false that omits it rejects every write the application makes — silently in tests, which use a template with no validator, and totally in production.

eventId.description: Event this escrow belongs to (unique per event)

organizerId.description: Event organizer user ID (Keycloak UUID format). Optional: an escrow is opened from the event-published envelope, which names the organization and not a person, so the organization is the tenant key and this stays unset until a user-level owner is recorded.

organizationId.description: OWASP A01 - Tenant isolation: Required for financial data

status.description: Configurable at runtime; the closed set lives on statusSemantic

statusSemantic.description: What status MEANS, denormalised from reference data. THIS is the closed set (OWASP A04) — the vocabulary is fixed in code while the codes above are not. null is allowed on purpose: a code with no reference-data row is left unclassified, which is findable, rather than guessed, which is not.

totalCommissions.description: Kept delta, recorded rather than removed
